_readme: Twelve neutral seed rows for tests/test_pilot_prompts_v2.py: more seeds than the pilot harness's K_EXEMPLARS (8), so a plan derived from them (common.derive_plan, as plan_calls.py runs it) shows in each Arm A call 8 seeds drawn from the seeded stream, some of which Arm B never shows, while every Arm B call shows the first 8 in file order. The recorded run's 6 seeds (pilot/seeds.json) give the other kind of Arm A block: all six seeds in drawn order. The words are placeholders with no medical vocabulary (engine AGENTS.md: vocabulary lives in data files, never in Python source); one row carries non-ASCII letters and one a double quote, which the exemplar block keeps and escapes as JSON.
